sources.description: The Las Vegas Raiders didn’t invest heavily in the defensive tackle position in free agency or the draft. One reason is the belief in the two draft picks from last season, Tonka Hemingway and JJ Pegues. Pegues got a sack during Sunday’s practice, but Hemingway has been performing well since day one.
